~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 5: Creating resistance surface
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Resistance surfaces for Etosha wet/dry, one per year (2008-2020)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)

# 0. Configuring
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label    <- "etosha"

gee_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data")
lc_dist_folder  <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
evi_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
out_folder      <- here("outputs", "resistance_surfaces")
lp_folder       <- here("outputs", "linear_predictors")
dir.create(out_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(lp_folder,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

lc_types <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")

crop_extent <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
target_res  <- 0.0045  # 500m in degrees
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

# 1. Load fitted SSF models and define valid area
# ------------------------------------------------------------
hydroyears_data <- readRDS(here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_by_hydroyear.rds"))
scaling_data    <- readRDS(here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_scaling.rds"))

fits_wet <- hydroyears_data$wet$fits   # names: "2010" "2011" "2012"
fits_dry <- hydroyears_data$dry$fits   # names: "2009" "2010" "2011"

# Area where the Etosha SSF is valid (used to mask out extrapolated pixels)
ele_trk_extract_etosha <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha.rds"))

etosha_pts <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(case_) |>          # used steps only (not random steps)
  select(x2_, y2_) |>
  drop_na()

etosha_vect <- vect(etosha_pts, geom = c("x2_", "y2_"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Convex hull + buffer to allow movement just beyond the outermost GPS fix
valid_area_etosha <- buffer(convHull(etosha_vect), width = 50000)

# 2. Build static covariate raster (seaonal)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_static_stack <- function() {
  static_files <- c(
    core_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "core_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    fence_dist = file.path(gee_folder, "fences_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    road_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "roads_distance_rast_500m.tif")
  )
  r_list  <- map(static_files, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- names(static_files)

  terrain_raw <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "terrain_rast_500m.tif"))

  # Aspect (degrees) -> northness/eastness, computed before reprojecting
  asp_rad    <- terrain_raw[["aspect"]] * pi / 180
  northness  <- cos(asp_rad); names(northness) <- "northness"
  eastness   <- sin(asp_rad); names(eastness)  <- "eastness"

  terrain_r <- c(terrain_raw[[c("elevation", "slope")]], northness, eastness)
  terrain_r <- project(terrain_r, template, method = "bilinear")

  c(r_stack, terrain_r)
}

build_linear_stack <- function() {
  linear_types  <- c("hydrorivers", "kaza_vet_fences", "roads")
  linear_folder <- here("data", "Linear_features")
  r_list <- map(linear_types, function(feature) {
    fp <- file.path(linear_folder, paste0(feature, "_linear_500m.tif"))
    project(rast(fp), template, method = "near")
  })
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(linear_types, "_linear")
  r_stack
}

load_world_pop_all <- function() {
  wp <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
  project(wp, template, method = "bilinear")
}

static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
linear_stack  <- build_linear_stack()
world_pop_all <- load_world_pop_all()

# 3. Build land-cover distance stack, average across year 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_lc_dist_year <- function(year) {
  paths <- setNames(
    file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc_types, "_", year, ".tif")),
    lc_types
  )
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]

  missing_lc <- setdiff(lc_types, names(paths))
  if (length(missing_lc) > 0) {
    warning("Land-cover distance rasters missing for ", year, ": ",
            paste(missing_lc, collapse = ", "))
  }

  r_list  <- map(paths, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(names(paths), "_dist")
  r_stack
}

# 4. Build EVI mean surface for given season
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_evi_year <- function(season, year) {
  fp <- if (season == "dry") {
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", year, ".tif"))
  } else {
    # wet season files span year boundaries: evi_wet_(yr-1)_(yr).tif
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", year - 1, "_", year, ".tif"))
  }
  if (!file.exists(fp)) stop("EVI raster not found for ", season, " ", year, ": ", fp)

  r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
  names(r) <- "evi"
  r
}

# 5. Build population mean surface across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_world_pop_year <- function(year) {
  layer_idx <- year - 1999  # matches indexing used in the SSF extraction script
  if (layer_idx < 1 || layer_idx > nlyr(world_pop_all)) {
    stop("No world_pop layer available for year ", year)
  }
  pop <- world_pop_all[[layer_idx]]
  names(pop) <- "world_pop"
  pop
}

# 6. Full covariate stack for one season
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_covariate_stack <- function(season, year) {
  c(static_stack,
    linear_stack,
    build_lc_dist_year(year),
    build_evi_year(season, year),
    build_world_pop_year(year))
}

# 7. Predict linear predictor / SSF from model coefficients (REVISED)
# -----------------------------------------------------------


# added scale matching layers in place, keep all other layers untouched and clamp to fitting-data range before scaling (prevents extrapolation)
scale_stack <- function(covariate_stack, scaling_tbl, clamp_to_fit = TRUE) {
  vars <- intersect(scaling_tbl$var, names(covariate_stack))
  out <- lapply(names(covariate_stack), function(v) {
    r <- covariate_stack[[v]]
    if (v %in% vars) {
      s <- scaling_tbl[scaling_tbl$var == v, ]
      if (clamp_to_fit) r <- clamp(r, lower = s$min, upper = s$max, values = TRUE)
      (r - s$mean) / s$sd
    } else r
  })
  r <- rast(out)
  names(r) <- names(covariate_stack)
  r
}

predict_ssf_surface <- function(model, covariate_stack, scaling_tbl) {
  betas <- if (!is.null(model$model)) coef(model$model) else coef(model)

  # changed to not drop NA coefficients silently
  if (any(is.na(betas))) {
    warning("NA coefficients dropped: ", paste(names(betas)[is.na(betas)], collapse = ", "))
  }
  betas <- betas[!is.na(betas)]

  missing_in_stack <- setdiff(names(betas), names(covariate_stack))
  if (length(missing_in_stack) > 0) {
    stop("Model covariates missing from raster stack: ",
         paste(missing_in_stack, collapse = ", "))
  }

#changed to actually apply the fitting-data scaling before multiplying by betas
  covariate_stack <- scale_stack(covariate_stack[[names(betas)]], scaling_tbl)

  weighted <- lapply(names(betas), function(nm) covariate_stack[[nm]] * betas[[nm]])
  lp <- sum(rast(weighted))
  names(lp) <- "linear_predictor"
  lp
}

# 8. Linear predictor to resistance surface
# ------------------------------------------------------------
lp_to_resistance <- function(lp, min_resistance = 1, max_resistance = 100,
                             clip = c(0.01, 0.99), clip_values = NULL) {

  q <- if (is.null(clip_values)) {
    as.numeric(quantile(values(lp, na.rm = TRUE), probs = clip))
  } else {
    clip_values
  }

  lp_c <- clamp(lp, lower = q[1], upper = q[2])
  h    <- (lp_c - q[1]) / (q[2] - q[1])   # 0 = least selected, 1 = most selected

  resistance <- max_resistance - (max_resistance - min_resistance) * h
  names(resistance) <- "resistance"
  resistance
}


#9. Run one season using its year-specific fits
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_resistance_all_years <- function(fits, season, pop_label, valid_area,
                                     scaling_tbl, common_clip = TRUE) {

  years   <- as.integer(names(fits))
  lp_list <- list()

  for (yr in years) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] building LP for ", yr)

    lp <- tryCatch({
      cov_stack <- build_covariate_stack(season, yr)
      mask(predict_ssf_surface(fits[[as.character(yr)]], cov_stack, scaling_tbl),
           valid_area)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Skipping ", season, " ", yr, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (is.null(lp)) next

    names(lp) <- paste0("lp_", yr)
    writeRaster(lp,
                file.path(lp_folder, paste0("lp_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    lp_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- lp
  }
  if (length(lp_list) == 0) stop("No years completed for ", season)

  # clip bounds pooled across the season's years so years are comparable
  clip_values <- NULL
  if (common_clip) {
    pooled <- unlist(lapply(lp_list, function(r) values(r, na.rm = TRUE)))
    clip_values <- as.numeric(quantile(pooled, probs = c(0.01, 0.99)))
    message("Common LP clip bounds: ", paste(round(clip_values, 3), collapse = " to "))
  }

  res_list <- list()
  for (yr in names(lp_list)) {
    res <- lp_to_resistance(lp_list[[yr]], clip_values = clip_values)
    writeRaster(res,
                file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    res_list[[yr]] <- res
  }

  lp_mean  <- mean(rast(lp_list))
  res_mean <- lp_to_resistance(lp_mean, clip_values = clip_values)
  yrs      <- as.integer(names(lp_list))
  writeRaster(res_mean,
              file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season,
                                           "_meanLP_", min(yrs), "-", max(yrs), ".tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE)

  by_year <- rast(res_list)
  names(by_year) <- names(res_list)
  list(by_year = by_year, mean_lp = res_mean)
}

#10. Run
# ------------------------------------------------------------
res_etosha_wet <- run_resistance_all_years(fits_wet, "wet", pop_label,
                                           valid_area_etosha, scaling_data$wet)
res_etosha_dry <- run_resistance_all_years(fits_dry, "dry", pop_label,
                                           valid_area_etosha, scaling_data$dry)

#11. Visualize
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot(res_etosha_wet$by_year)   # 2010, 2011, 2012
plot(res_etosha_dry$by_year)   # 2009, 2010, 2011
plot(res_etosha_wet$mean_lp, main = "Etosha Wet Resistance (mean LP)")
plot(res_etosha_dry$mean_lp, main = "Etosha Dry Resistance (mean LP)")

```

hydroyears_data <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/outputs/etosha_ssf_base_by_hydroyear.rds")

# 3. Inspect the structure and summary of the data
str(hydroyears_data)       # Shows data types and structure
summary(hydroyears_data)   # Provides statistical summaries

#make sure that the wet and dry season lines up right in code
check_fits <- function(season) {
  smp  <- hydroyears_data[[season]]$samples
  fits <- hydroyears_data[[season]]$fits
  map_dfr(names(fits), function(yr) {
    m <- fits[[yr]]$model
    tibble(
      season         = season,
      hydro_year     = as.integer(yr),
      nevent_model   = m$nevent,
      n_used_samples = smp$n_used[smp$hydro_year == as.integer(yr)],
      match          = nevent_model == n_used_samples
    )
  })
}

bind_rows(check_fits("wet"), check_fits("dry"))

cov_stack <- build_covariate_stack("wet")
betas <- coef(m0_etosha_wet$model); betas <- betas[!is.na(betas)]
cs <- mask(cov_stack[[names(betas)]], valid_area)

# per-term contribution (beta * value), so you can see which one steps at ~14.9
contrib <- rast(lapply(names(betas), function(nm) cs[[nm]] * betas[[nm]]))
names(contrib) <- names(betas)
plot(contrib, nc = 4)          # look for the layer with the vertical edge

# west vs east of the seam, ranked by size of the jump
w <- ext(14.3, 14.8, -19.2, -18.4); e <- ext(15.1, 15.6, -19.2, -18.4)
jump <- data.frame(
  term = names(betas),
  west = global(crop(contrib, w), "mean", na.rm = TRUE)[, 1],
  east = global(crop(contrib, e), "mean", na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]
)
jump$diff <- jump$east - jump$west
jump[order(-abs(jump$diff)), ]

# which layer is NA over the pan
global(is.na(cs), "sum")

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#Resistance sutface for KAZA wet/dry 
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)

# 0. Configuring
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label    <- "kaza"
target_years <- 2008:2020          # <- replaces single target_year

gee_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data")
lc_dist_folder  <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
evi_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
model_folder    <- here("outputs")
out_folder      <- here("outputs", "resistance_surfaces")
lp_folder       <- here("outputs", "linear_predictors")
dir.create(out_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(lp_folder,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

lc_types    <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")
wet_months  <- c(1:4, 11:12)
dry_months  <- c(5:10)

crop_extent <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
target_res  <- 0.0045  # 500m in degrees
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

# 1. Load fitted SSF modles
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#load only covariates
m0_wet_kaza <- readRDS(here("outputs", "m0_kaza_wet_coefonly.rds"))
m0_dry_kaza <- readRDS(here("outputs", "m0_kaza_dry_coefonly.rds"))

valid_area_kaza <- vect(here("outputs", "kaza_valid_area.gpkg"))

# 2. Build static covariate raster (seaonal)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_static_stack <- function() {

  # CHECK: SSF extraction used "core_dist_rast_500m.tif" (no "_new"). Use the same file as extraction.
  static_files <- c(
    core_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "core_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    fence_dist = file.path(gee_folder, "fences_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    road_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "roads_distance_rast_500m.tif")
  )

  r_list  <- map(static_files, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- names(static_files)

  terrain_r <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "terrain_rast_500m.tif"))
  terrain_r <- project(terrain_r, template, method = "bilinear")

  c(r_stack, terrain_r)
}

#Linear feature stack 
build_linear_stack <- function() {

  linear_types  <- c("hydrorivers", "kaza_vet_fences", "roads")
  linear_folder <- here("data", "Linear_features")

  r_list <- map(linear_types, function(feature) {
    fp <- file.path(linear_folder, paste0(feature, "_linear_500m.tif"))
    project(rast(fp), template, method = "near")
  })
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(linear_types, "_linear")
  r_stack
}

# WorldPop: load + project all layers once; pull one layer per year later
load_world_pop_all <- function() {
  wp <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
  project(wp, template, method = "bilinear")
}

static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
linear_stack  <- build_linear_stack()
world_pop_all <- load_world_pop_all()

# 3. Build land-cover distance stack, average across year 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_lc_dist_year <- function(year) {

  paths <- setNames(
    file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc_types, "_", year, ".tif")),
    lc_types
  )
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]

  missing_lc <- setdiff(lc_types, names(paths))
  if (length(missing_lc) > 0) {
    warning("Land-cover distance rasters missing for ", year, ": ",
            paste(missing_lc, collapse = ", "))
  }

  r_list  <- map(paths, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(names(paths), "_dist")
  r_stack
}

# 4. Build EVI mean surface for given season
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_evi_year <- function(season, year) {

  fp <- if (season == "dry") {
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", year, ".tif"))
  } else {
    # wet season files span year boundaries: evi_wet_(yr-1)_(yr).tif
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", year - 1, "_", year, ".tif"))
  }

  if (!file.exists(fp)) {
    stop("EVI raster not found for ", season, " ", year, ": ", fp)
  }

  r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
  names(r) <- "evi"
  r
}

# 5. Build population mean surface across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_world_pop_year <- function(year) {
  layer_idx <- year - 1999  # matches indexing used in the SSF extraction script
  if (layer_idx < 1 || layer_idx > nlyr(world_pop_all)) {
    stop("No world_pop layer available for year ", year)
  }
  pop <- world_pop_all[[layer_idx]]
  names(pop) <- "world_pop"
  pop
}


# 6. Full covariate stack for one season
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_covariate_stack <- function(season, year) {
  c(static_stack,
    linear_stack,
    build_lc_dist_year(year),
    build_evi_year(season, year),
    build_world_pop_year(year))
}

# 7. Predict linear predictor / SSF from model coefficients (REVISED)
# -----------------------------------------------------------

predict_ssf_surface <- function(model, covariate_stack) {
 
  #fit_clogit() function wraps the model inside '$model', so extract '$model' here to get correct coefficients 
  #betas <- coef(model$model) #pulls out statistical weights calculated by SSF
  #replaced since there is no saved model
  betas <- if (!is.null(model$model)) coef(model$model) else coef(model)
  betas <- betas[!is.na(betas)]  # Remove any variables that failed to calculate (ignore NA values) 
  
  
  #TAKING A SUBSET OF COVARIATES
  # if (!is.null(keep)) betas <- betas[names(betas) %in% keep]
 # if (length(betas) == 0) stop("None of the requested covariates are in the model.")
 # message("Using: ", paste(names(betas), collapse = ", "))
  
  
#compare names of varibales in the model against the names of the map layers provided. Creates a list of any required varibales that are missing from the map. If there is something missing, triggers an error and prints what is missing
  missing_in_stack <- setdiff(names(betas), names(covariate_stack))
  if (length(missing_in_stack) > 0) {
    stop("Model covariates missing from raster stack: ",
         paste(missing_in_stack, collapse = ", "))
  }
 
  #using name based indexing to prevent the wrong coefficient multiplying by the wrong variable. Retrieves corresponding layer and multiplies that entire layer by its matching scalar weight. 
  weighted <- lapply(names(betas), function(nm) covariate_stack[[nm]] * betas[[nm]])
  
  #sums all the weighted layers into a linear predictor 
  lp <- sum(rast(weighted))   #linear predictor surface
  names(lp) <- "linear_predictor"
  lp
  
}

# 8. Linear predictor to resistance surface
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lp_to_resistance <- function(lp, min_resistance = 1, max_resistance = 100,
                             clip = c(0.01, 0.99), clip_values = NULL) {
#mess around with shape parameter 

#Takes 1st percentile and 99th percentile values of preference scores and cuts any below or above this because extreme outliers
  q <- if (is.null(clip_values)) {
    as.numeric(quantile(values(lp, na.rm = TRUE), probs = clip))
  } else clip_values
  lp_c <- clamp(lp, lower = q[1], upper = q[2])
  
  # Uses min max normalization to transform preferences into h, a scale running from 0 to 1 (0 = least selected habitat, 1 = most selected habitat)
  h <- (lp_c - q[1]) / (q[2] - q[1])
  
  # Non-linear Exponential Resistance Transformation
  # As h approaches 1 (high selection), resistance approaches min_resistance 
  # As h approaches 0 (lower selection), resistance rises toward max_resistance
  # shape_parameter controls curvature (larger = resistance drops off faster as habitat improves)
  # the (1 - exp(-c*h)) / (1 - exp(-c)) term is already scaled to 0-1, so resistance hits exactly min/max without a separate rescaling step.
  #resistance <- max_resistance -
    #(max_resistance - min_resistance) *
    #((1 - exp(-shape_parameter * h)) / (1 - exp(-shape_parameter)))
  
  # Linear transformation:
  # h = 1 (high selection) -> min_resistance
  # h = 0 (low selection)  -> max_resistance
  resistance <- max_resistance - (max_resistance - min_resistance) * h
  
  names(resistance) <- "resistance"
  
  resistance
 
}

#9. Run season across all years 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_resistance_all_years <- function(model, season, pop_label, valid_area,
                                     years = target_years,
                                     common_clip = TRUE) {

#Linear predictor for each year
  lp_list <- list()
  for (yr in years) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] building LP for ", yr)

    lp <- tryCatch({
      cov_stack <- build_covariate_stack(season, yr)
      mask(predict_ssf_surface(model, cov_stack), valid_area)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Skipping ", season, " ", yr, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (is.null(lp)) next

    names(lp) <- paste0("lp_", yr)
    writeRaster(lp,
                file.path(lp_folder, paste0("lp_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    lp_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- lp
  }
  if (length(lp_list) == 0) stop("No years completed for ", season)

#Clip bounds
  clip_values <- NULL
  if (common_clip) {
    pooled <- unlist(lapply(lp_list, function(r) values(r, na.rm = TRUE)))
    clip_values <- as.numeric(quantile(pooled, probs = c(0.01, 0.99)))
    message("Common LP clip bounds: ", paste(round(clip_values, 3), collapse = " to "))
  }

#resistance surface per year
  res_list <- list()
  for (yr in names(lp_list)) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] resistance for ", yr)
    res <- lp_to_resistance(lp_list[[yr]], clip_values = clip_values)
    writeRaster(res,
                file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    res_list[[yr]] <- res
  }

#resistance from the mean LP across years (same clip bounds)
  lp_mean  <- mean(rast(lp_list))
  res_mean <- lp_to_resistance(lp_mean, clip_values = clip_values)
  yrs      <- as.integer(names(lp_list))
  writeRaster(res_mean,
              file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season,
                                           "_meanLP_", min(yrs), "-", max(yrs), ".tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE)

  by_year <- rast(res_list)
  names(by_year) <- names(res_list)   # layer names become the years, e.g. "2008"
  list(by_year = by_year, mean_lp = res_mean)
}

# 10. Run
# ------------------------------------------------------------
res_kaza_wet <- run_resistance_all_years(m0_wet_kaza, "wet", pop_label, valid_area_kaza, common_clip = TRUE)
res_kaza_dry <- run_resistance_all_years(m0_dry_kaza, "dry", pop_label, valid_area_kaza, common_clip = TRUE)

# 11. Visualize
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot(res_kaza_wet$by_year[[c("2010", "2015", "2020")]])
plot(res_kaza_dry$by_year[[c("2010", "2015", "2020")]])
plot(res_kaza_wet$mean_lp, main = "KAZA Wet Resistance (mean LP)")
plot(res_kaza_dry$mean_lp,main = "KAZA Dry Resistance (mean LP)")
plet(res_kaza_wet$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")
plet(res_kaza_dry$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Resistance surfaces for Western wet/dry, one per year (2008-2020)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)

# 0. Configuring
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label    <- "western"
target_years <- 2008:2020

gee_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data")
lc_dist_folder  <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
evi_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
out_folder      <- here("outputs", "resistance_surfaces")
lp_folder       <- here("outputs", "linear_predictors")
dir.create(out_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(lp_folder,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

lc_types <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")

crop_extent <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
target_res  <- 0.0045  # 500m in degrees
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

# 1. Load fitted SSF models and define valid area
# ------------------------------------------------------------
m0_west_wet <- readRDS(here("outputs", "m0_west_wet.rds"))
m0_west_dry <- readRDS(here("outputs", "m0_west_dry.rds"))

# Area where the West SSF is valid (used to mask out extrapolated pixels)
ele_trk_extract_west <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_west.rds"))

west_pts <- ele_trk_extract_west |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(case_) |>          # used steps only (not random steps)
  select(x2_, y2_) |>
  drop_na()

west_vect <- vect(west_pts, geom = c("x2_", "y2_"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Convex hull + buffer to allow movement just beyond the outermost GPS fix
valid_area_west <- buffer(convHull(west_vect), width = 50000)

# 2. Build static covariate raster (seaonal)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_static_stack <- function() {
  # CHECK: SSF extraction used "core_dist_rast_500m.tif" (no "_new")
  static_files <- c(
    core_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "core_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    fence_dist = file.path(gee_folder, "fences_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    road_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "roads_distance_rast_500m.tif")
  )
  r_list  <- map(static_files, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- names(static_files)

  terrain_r <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "terrain_rast_500m.tif"))
  terrain_r <- project(terrain_r, template, method = "bilinear")

  c(r_stack, terrain_r)
}

build_linear_stack <- function() {
  linear_types  <- c("hydrorivers", "kaza_vet_fences", "roads")
  linear_folder <- here("data", "Linear_features")
  r_list <- map(linear_types, function(feature) {
    fp <- file.path(linear_folder, paste0(feature, "_linear_500m.tif"))
    project(rast(fp), template, method = "near")
  })
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(linear_types, "_linear")
  r_stack
}

load_world_pop_all <- function() {
  wp <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
  project(wp, template, method = "bilinear")
}

static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
linear_stack  <- build_linear_stack()
world_pop_all <- load_world_pop_all()

# 3. Build land-cover distance stack, average across year 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_lc_dist_year <- function(year) {
  paths <- setNames(
    file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc_types, "_", year, ".tif")),
    lc_types
  )
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]

  missing_lc <- setdiff(lc_types, names(paths))
  if (length(missing_lc) > 0) {
    warning("Land-cover distance rasters missing for ", year, ": ",
            paste(missing_lc, collapse = ", "))
  }

  r_list  <- map(paths, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(names(paths), "_dist")
  r_stack
}

# 4. Build EVI mean surface for given season
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_evi_year <- function(season, year) {
  fp <- if (season == "dry") {
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", year, ".tif"))
  } else {
    # wet season files span year boundaries: evi_wet_(yr-1)_(yr).tif
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", year - 1, "_", year, ".tif"))
  }
  if (!file.exists(fp)) stop("EVI raster not found for ", season, " ", year, ": ", fp)

  r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
  names(r) <- "evi"
  r
}

# 5. Build population mean surface across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_world_pop_year <- function(year) {
  layer_idx <- year - 1999  # matches indexing used in the SSF extraction script
  if (layer_idx < 1 || layer_idx > nlyr(world_pop_all)) {
    stop("No world_pop layer available for year ", year)
  }
  pop <- world_pop_all[[layer_idx]]
  names(pop) <- "world_pop"
  pop
}

# 6. Full covariate stack for one season
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_covariate_stack <- function(season, year) {
  c(static_stack,
    linear_stack,
    build_lc_dist_year(year),
    build_evi_year(season, year),
    build_world_pop_year(year))
}

# 7. Predict linear predictor / SSF from model coefficients (REVISED)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
predict_ssf_surface <- function(model, covariate_stack) {
  # fit_clogit() wraps the model in '$model'; fall back to the object itself if not
  betas <- if (!is.null(model$model)) coef(model$model) else coef(model)
  betas <- betas[!is.na(betas)]

  missing_in_stack <- setdiff(names(betas), names(covariate_stack))
  if (length(missing_in_stack) > 0) {
    stop("Model covariates missing from raster stack: ",
         paste(missing_in_stack, collapse = ", "))
  }

  weighted <- lapply(names(betas), function(nm) covariate_stack[[nm]] * betas[[nm]])
  lp <- sum(rast(weighted))
  names(lp) <- "linear_predictor"
  lp
}

# 8. Linear predictor to resistance surface
# ------------------------------------------------------------
lp_to_resistance <- function(lp, min_resistance = 1, max_resistance = 100,
                             clip = c(0.01, 0.99), clip_values = NULL) {

  q <- if (is.null(clip_values)) {
    as.numeric(quantile(values(lp, na.rm = TRUE), probs = clip))
  } else {
    clip_values
  }

  lp_c <- clamp(lp, lower = q[1], upper = q[2])
  h    <- (lp_c - q[1]) / (q[2] - q[1])   # 0 = least selected, 1 = most selected

  resistance <- max_resistance - (max_resistance - min_resistance) * h
  names(resistance) <- "resistance"
  resistance
}

#9. Run season across all years 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_resistance_all_years <- function(model, season, pop_label, valid_area,
                                     years = target_years,
                                     common_clip = TRUE) {

#linear predictor for each year
  lp_list <- list()
  for (yr in years) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] building LP for ", yr)

    lp <- tryCatch({
      cov_stack <- build_covariate_stack(season, yr)
      mask(predict_ssf_surface(model, cov_stack), valid_area)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Skipping ", season, " ", yr, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (is.null(lp)) next

    names(lp) <- paste0("lp_", yr)
    writeRaster(lp,
                file.path(lp_folder, paste0("lp_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    lp_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- lp
  }
  if (length(lp_list) == 0) stop("No years completed for ", season)

#clip bounds (pooled across years if common_clip = TRUE)
  clip_values <- NULL
  if (common_clip) {
    pooled <- unlist(lapply(lp_list, function(r) values(r, na.rm = TRUE)))
    clip_values <- as.numeric(quantile(pooled, probs = c(0.01, 0.99)))
    message("Common LP clip bounds: ", paste(round(clip_values, 3), collapse = " to "))
  }

#resistance surface per year
  res_list <- list()
  for (yr in names(lp_list)) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] resistance for ", yr)
    res <- lp_to_resistance(lp_list[[yr]], clip_values = clip_values)
    writeRaster(res,
                file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    res_list[[yr]] <- res
  }

  # Step D: resistance from the mean LP across years (same clip bounds)
  lp_mean  <- mean(rast(lp_list))
  res_mean <- lp_to_resistance(lp_mean, clip_values = clip_values)
  yrs      <- as.integer(names(lp_list))
  writeRaster(res_mean,
              file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season,
                                           "_meanLP_", min(yrs), "-", max(yrs), ".tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE)

  by_year <- rast(res_list)
  names(by_year) <- names(res_list)   # layer names = years

  list(by_year = by_year, mean_lp = res_mean)
}

#10. Run
# ------------------------------------------------------------
res_west_wet <- run_resistance_all_years(m0_west_wet, "wet", pop_label, valid_area_west, common_clip = TRUE)
res_west_dry <- run_resistance_all_years(m0_west_dry, "dry", pop_label, valid_area_west, common_clip = TRUE)

#11. Visualize
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot(res_west_wet$by_year[[c("2010", "2015", "2020")]])
plot(res_west_dry$by_year[[c("2010", "2015", "2020")]])
plot(res_west_wet$mean_lp,           main = "West Wet Resistance (mean LP)")
plot(res_west_dry$mean_lp,           main = "West Dry Resistance (mean LP)")
plet(res_west_wet$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")

used_steps <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(case_) |>                                   # used steps only
  mutate(hydro_year = if_else(month(t1_) >= 11, year(t1_) + 1L, year(t1_))) |>  # same as the SSF scripts
  select(x2_, y2_, season, hydro_year) |>
  drop_na()

plot_res_with_steps <- function(res_by_year, season_name) {
  par(mfrow = c(1, nlyr(res_by_year)))
  for (yr in names(res_by_year)) {
    pts <- filter(used_steps, season == season_name, hydro_year == as.integer(yr))
    plot(res_by_year[[yr]], ext = ext(valid_area_etosha),
         main = paste0("Etosha ", season_name, " ", yr, " (n = ", nrow(pts), " steps)"))
    points(pts$x2_, pts$y2_, pch = 16, cex = 0.1,
           col = adjustcolor("red", alpha.f = 0.05))
  }
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

plot_res_with_steps(res_etosha_wet$by_year, "wet")   # 2010, 2011, 2012
plot_res_with_steps(res_etosha_dry$by_year, "dry")   # 2009, 2010, 2011
